faqs.question: How are the delicate mirrors and clay reliefs protected during shipping?
faqs.answer: Every artwork is encased in shock-absorbent custom foam, wrapped in moisture-resistant film, and secured within a 5-layer heavy-duty wooden reinforcement crate to ensure 100% transit safety across India.

faqs.question: Are these authentic handmade Lippan artworks?
faqs.answer: Yes, each artwork is 100% hand-sculpted by Master Craftsman Murli Prasad in Rohtak, Haryana, using traditional clay relief paste, genuine glass mirrors, and premium wooden backings.

faqs.question: Can I request custom sizes or specific deity designs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We create customized pieces tailored to your exact wall dimensions, interior color schemes, and pooja mandir requirements. Simply reach out via WhatsApp or our Contact page.

faqs.question: What is the expected delivery timeframe?
faqs.answer: In-stock pieces are dispatched within 2 business days and delivered within 4-7 business days across India. Custom commissions typically take 10-15 business days depending on design complexity.
